description: Source code file extending the ChannelsSettings class with private methods, computed properties, and UI-related functions for managing and displaying the status and details of various communication channels such as WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Google Chat, Signal, and iMessage in a SwiftUI application.

classes.name: ChannelsSettings
classes.description: Extension providing additional private methods, computed properties, and UI components for managing communication channel statuses and display details in a SwiftUI app.

methods.name: channelStatus
methods.description: Retrieves and decodes the channel status snapshot of a specific type for a given channel ID.

methods.name: configuredChannelTint
methods.description: Determines the UI tint color for a channel based on its configuration and error state.

methods.name: configuredChannelSummary
methods.description: Provides a textual summary of whether a channel is configured and running.

methods.name: appendProbeDetails
methods.description: Appends detailed probe and connection info to a list of strings, used in channel detail displays.

methods.name: finishDetails
methods.description: Aggregates probe details into a final status string for display.

methods.name: finishProbeDetails
methods.description: Finalizes the probe-related details string for a channel.

methods.name: whatsAppTint
methods.description: Computed property returning the color representing WhatsApp channel status.

methods.name: telegramTint
methods.description: Computed property returning the color representing Telegram channel status.

methods.name: discordTint
methods.description: Computed property returning the color representing Discord channel status.

methods.name: googlechatTint
methods.description: Computed property returning the color representing Google Chat channel status.

methods.name: signalTint
methods.description: Computed property returning the color representing Signal channel status.

methods.name: imessageTint
methods.description: Computed property returning the color representing iMessage channel status.

methods.name: whatsAppSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summary of WhatsApp channel connection status.

methods.name: telegramSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summary of Telegram channel configuration.

methods.name: discordSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summary of Discord channel configuration.

methods.name: googlechatSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summary of Google Chat channel configuration.

methods.name: signalSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summary of Signal channel configuration.

methods.name: imessageSummary
methods.description: Returns a string summary of iMessage channel configuration.

methods.name: whatsAppDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed status string for WhatsApp channel, including linked info, last connection, disconnect, and error details.

methods.name: telegramDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed status string for Telegram channel, including token source, mode, probe info, and last probe details.

methods.name: discordDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed status string for Discord channel, including token source, bot info, and probe details.

methods.name: googlechatDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed status string for Google Chat channel, including credential source, audience, and probe info.

methods.name: signalDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed string for Signal channel, including base URL and probe info.

methods.name: imessageDetails
methods.description: Provides detailed string for iMessage channel, including CLI and database paths and probe info.

methods.name: orderedChannels
methods.description: Returns a list of channel items ordered by a predefined or stored channel order.

methods.name: enabledChannels
methods.description: Filters and returns channels that are enabled.

methods.name: availableChannels
methods.description: Filters and returns channels that are available but not enabled.

methods.name: ensureSelection
methods.description: Ensures that a channel is selected; defaults to the first available channel if none selected.

methods.name: channelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given channel is enabled based on its status and account activity.

methods.name: channelSection
methods.description: Builds the UI section for a given channel, with special handling for WhatsApp.

methods.name: channelTint
methods.description: Determines the UI color tint for a channel in the interface.

methods.name: channelSummary
methods.description: Provides a brief textual summary of a channel's status.

methods.name: channelDetails
methods.description: Provides a detailed string description for a channel's status.

methods.name: channelLastCheckText
methods.description: Returns the relative age string since the last check of a channel.

methods.name: channelLastCheck
methods.description: Returns the Date object representing the last check time of a channel.

methods.name: channelHasError
methods.description: Determines if a channel currently has an error state.

methods.name: resolveChannelTitle
methods.description: Resolves the display title for a specified channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelDetailTitle
methods.description: Resolves the detailed label for a specified channel ID.

methods.name: resolveChannelSystemImage
methods.description: Resolves the system image icon name for a specified channel ID.

methods.name: channelStatusDictionary
methods.description: Retrieves the channel status as a dictionary for a given channel ID.
